verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a game engine, so profiling and data-oriented scaling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a profiler, ECS, a job system or instancing. Native C++/C# support is only a developer building block and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
